bullets.section: What I’m reading (and going to listen to) —
bullets.title: The 50 Best Podcast Episodes of 2018
bullets.note: This is a spectacular list of great podcast episodes. The topics are varied, often unexpected, and hit the nail on the head for me in a bunch of cases. I’ll be listening to many podcasts I never would have found on my own.

bullets.title: Package Thief vs. Glitter Bomb Trap
bullets.note: I don’t watch much on YouTube, but this was sent to me by three separate people. It’s definitely worth the entire 9–10 minutes. Save it for an after-work treat, if needed. If you’ve ever had packages stolen, as I have, this will put a smile on your face.

bullets.title: TOMS’ attempt to help end gun violence
bullets.note: TOMS founder Blake Mycoskie grew up hunting in Texas. He and I both own guns. He is pro Second Amendment, pro hunting, etc. At the same time, prompted by seemingly endless tragedies in the US, he wanted to try and curb needless gun-related danger and risks. How? By putting pressure on politicians to push forward with universal background checks, something ~90% of Americans — including conservatives — agree is a good idea. If you [head to this page on TOMS](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/o8uvgq544hqh7z802/56cvh7hr93o2g/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cudG9tcy5jb20vdGFrZWFjdGlvbg==) and spend 10 seconds filling out a few fields, they will print and mail a postcard to Congress, demanding that they take action now. This campaign has received support from church pastors, country musicians, hip-hop artists (e.g., Snoop Dogg), and millions more from every walk of life. It’s not about banning guns (and I say this as a gun owner); it’s about reducing unnecessary risk and saving lives with low-hanging fruit.

bullets.title: Robert Caro
bullets.note: (born October 30, 1935) is an American journalist and author known for his biographies of US political figures Robert Moses and Lyndon B. Johnson. After working for many years as a reporter, Caro wrote [_The Power Broker_](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/o8uvgq544hqh7z802/3raphkhedx9gv/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYW1hem9uLmNvbS9Qb3dlci1Ccm9rZXItUm9iZXJ0LU1vc2VzLUZhbGwvZHAvMDM5NDcyMDI0NQ==) (1974), a biography of New York urban planner Robert Moses, which was chosen by the Modern Library as [one of the hundred greatest nonfiction books](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/o8uvgq544hqh7z802/40bvheh42wq8w/aHR0cDovL3d3dy5tb2Rlcm5saWJyYXJ5LmNvbS90b3AtMTAwLzEwMC1iZXN0LW5vbmZpY3Rpb24v) of the twentieth century. He has since written four of a planned five volumes of [_The Years of Lyndon Johnson_](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/o8uvgq544hqh7z802/0nhwh9h37nwre/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYW1hem9uLmNvbS9QYXRoLVBvd2VyLVllYXJzLUx5bmRvbi1Kb2huc29uL2RwLzA2Nzk3Mjk0NTM=) (1982, 1990, 2002, 2012), a biography of the former president.
